title: Roblox Bye
blurb: The Roblox 'bye' — the squeaky farewell twin of the Roblox hi. It's the sound of leaving the server, the call, the conversation, delivered with the same unearned cheerfulness regardless of what just happened. Rage quit? Bye. Won everything? Bye. Emotional damage inflicted? Bye. All exits are equal in Roblox. Byeeee.
origin: The cheerful farewell from Roblox voice/chat culture.
